report.summary: The database file was read-only, so checkout failed with a 500. The other four checks passed because they only read from the database. I made data/shop.db writable, and all 5 smoke tests now pass, including a persisted checkout. Before the fix, two failed checkouts (pay_5862001b51 and pay_f751c0e4b5) were charged by the provider but not saved as orders. They look like smoke-test charges, but someone should confirm that and refund them if they were real.
